parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 100x (AP2127K-3.3TRG1: 1 µF p.12 vs TLV73333PDBVR: 0 µF p.16); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: AP2127K-3.3TRG1 requires Vin,min >= 2.5 V (p.4) vs 1.4 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP2127K-3.3TRG1: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C TA) vs TLV73333PDBVR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ)); AP2127K-3.3TRG1 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AP2127K-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-5) and TLV73333PDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because minimum output capacitance requirement differs 100x; Vin,min floor rises 1.1 V; ambient temperature grade differs (-40..85 °C vs -40..125 °C). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 63.8 °C on AP2127K-3.3TRG1 (θJA 250 °C/W) vs 58.2 °C on TLV73333PDBVR (θJA 228.4 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 1.8x ratio (60 µA (p.5) vs 34 µA (p.6)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP2127K-3.3TRG1 "High 250 °C/W SOT-23-5 θJA Caps Continuous Power at 400 mW (25°C) — Derate From 5 V" (p.13) and TLV73333PDBVR "Tight 3.6 V Absolute Maximum on VOUT & VEN <= VIN + 0.3 V Sequencing Limit" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose AP2127K-3.3TRG1 when matching your existing Diodes Incorporated SOT-23-5 (K (SOT-23-5)) qualification and -40..85 °C grade; choose TLV73333PDBVR when battery sleep budget demands 34 µA Iq. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.4) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
